slides.texte_overlay:
small things confident
people do without thinking

they hold their opinion

they share what they think calmly and don't take it back just to avoid a small argument. a kind, steady opinion earns far more respect than nervous silence.

they let pauses breathe

silence in a conversation doesn't scare them. they don't rush to fill every gap, and that calm makes everyone around them relax a little more around them.

they always have a story

confident people always have one unexpected topic to share, because they keep learning. surprising stories make every conversation easier and much more fun.
slides.texte_sophia:
they always have a story

i always have one unexpected story ready now. i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a strange myth or a fact, and conversations come alive instantly.

slides.texte_overlay:
they speak to the end

they finish their sentences clearly instead of trailing off with or something. finishing a thought properly makes everything they say sound more certain.

they act despite nerves

they don't tell everyone how nervous they are before doing something. they feel the nerves, and then they simply do it anyway without making a big scene.
